verdicts.reason: Both use the same crop of the fig photo, and both keep the headline and wreath over the image. A shrinks the 'Perfect Taste' lockup so much that it looks lost in the frame and is hard to read at 300x250. Its wreath also crowds the busy figs on the right without becoming a focal point. B gives the headline a larger, more legible lockup that reads as the clear focal point, as in the original. However, the end of 'Taste' and the right side of B's wreath sit against the busy fig slices, which weakens contrast. Neither version reworks the composition much for the format.
